value.heading: Myth: Estate planning is too expensive.
value.text: Reality: Unlike traditional law firms that bill by the hour, Trustist operates on a transparent, fixed-pricing model. You know exactly what your legacy protection costs before we begin, with no surprise invoices or hidden fees.

value.heading: Myth: The process is overwhelmingly complex.
value.text: Reality: We have distilled decades of legal expertise into a streamlined, guided experience. Our proprietary platform and dedicated advisors handle the heavy lifting, turning a daunting task into a clear, manageable path.

value.heading: Myth: My estate details will become public record.
value.text: Reality: Unlike a standard will that must pass through probate—a public, time-consuming process—a properly structured trust keeps your assets and family details entirely private, protecting your loved ones from unnecessary exposure.
